# Husain Hakim — Offensive Security & Cybersecurity Workspace
> A specialized portfolio and virtual filesystem workspace showcasing offensive security research, penetration testing tools, SUID privilege escalation writeups, and low-level network engineering.

Husain Hakim is a Cybersecurity student at ITM Skills University (B.Tech CSE, 2023–2027) focused on ethical hacking, offensive security, vulnerability discovery, network reconnaissance, and secure backend systems.

## Core Competencies & Pillars
- Reconnaissance & Asset Discovery (Subnet sweeping, port probing, ARP/mDNS dissection)
- Network Protocol Analysis & Security Tooling (Zero-dependency raw sockets, packet telemetry)
- Authentication & Password Security Audits (Hashcat/John entropy scoring, dictionary resistance)
- Linux Internals & Privilege Escalation (SUID binary exploitation, cron misuse, capabilities)
- File Integrity & Reverse Engineering (Magic byte / header verification, polyglot file detection)

## Key Projects
- **CYBER // SONAR**: Fast, multi-threaded offensive network scanner built in Python. Performs automated subnet sweeps, ARP host discovery, TCP port auditing, and service banner grabbing.
  - URL: https://husainhakim.me/projects/cyber-sonar
  - Repository: https://github.com/husainhakim/cyber-sonar

- **File Signature & Magic Number Detector**: Tactical binary analysis utility to inspect magic bytes, identify hidden payloads/polyglot files, and combat MIME-type spoofing.
  - URL: https://husainhakim.me/projects/file-signature-detector
  - Repository: https://github.com/husainhakim/file-signature-detector

- **Password Entropy & Hash Audit Suite**: Password strength verification and cryptographic hashing utility evaluating entropy resistance against brute-force/dictionary attacks.
  - URL: https://husainhakim.me/projects/password-audit-suite
  - Repository: https://github.com/husainhakim/password-audit-suite

- **Linux SUID Capability Auditor**: Automated enumeration tool for misconfigured SUID/SGID binaries and Linux POSIX capabilities.
  - URL: https://husainhakim.me/projects/suid-capability-auditor
  - Repository: https://github.com/husainhakim/suid-capability-auditor

## Security Research Writeups
- **SUID Binary Exploitation & Privilege Escalation**: Comprehensive methodology on identifying and exploiting misconfigured SUID binaries in Linux environments (GTFOBins, PATH hijacking, shared library injection).
  - URL: https://husainhakim.me/writeups/network-security/suid-privilege-escalation

- **Network Reconnaissance & Port Scanning Methodologies**: Deep dive into active vs passive scanning, TCP SYN half-open probes, FIN/Xmas scans, and firewall bypass techniques.
  - URL: https://husainhakim.me/writeups/network-security/network-recon-methodology

- **SQL Injection Defense & Parameterized Architecture**: Technical analysis of second-order injection vulnerabilities and parameterized query mitigation strategies.
  - URL: https://husainhakim.me/writeups/web-security/sqli-parameterized-defense

- **Authentication Logic Flaws & Rate Limiting Bypass**: Research on token invalidation vulnerabilities, OTP race conditions, and cryptographic nonce validation.
  - URL: https://husainhakim.me/writeups/web-security/auth-logic-flaws
